title: Colombo spiced sweet potato and red bean stew
blurb: A warmly spiced Caribbean-style stew with tender sweet potatoes and red beans in a fragrant Colombo curry sauce.
steps: Peel and dice the onion, then peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into chunks about two centimetres across.
Peel and finely chop the garlic and ginger, then drain and rinse the kidney beans.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and cook the onion for five minutes until softened.
Add the garlic, ginger and Colombo curry powder and stir for one minute until fragrant.
Roughly chop the tomatoes and add them to the pan with the sweet potato chunks, kidney beans and vegetable stock.
Bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat and cook gently for twenty-five minutes until the sweet potatoes are tender.
Season with salt, then tear the basil leaves and stir them through just before serving.
